response.sql:
WITH station_counts AS (
  SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count
  FROM observatories AS o
  LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation
), shares AS (
  SELECT observstation, telescope_count,
         1.0 * telescope_count / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes), 0) AS share
  FROM station_counts
), scored AS (
  SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share,
         share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares) AS difference
  FROM shares
), eligible AS (
  SELECT * FROM scored
  WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY difference DESC) AS difference_rank
  FROM eligible
)
SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, difference
FROM ranked
WHERE difference_rank <= 10
ORDER BY difference DESC;

assumptions.assumption: All rows in observatories are included, including stations with zero telescopes; the average share is the unweighted average across all observatory stations.
